'''Guan Weiyan''' ({{zh|s=管惟炎}}; August 18, 1928 – March 20, 2003<ref>{{Cite web |title=管惟炎----中国科学院学部 |url=http://casad.cas.cn/sourcedb_ad_cas/zw2/ysxx/ygysmd/200906/t20090624_1810109.html |access-date=2022-07-28 |website=casad.cas.cn}}</ref>) was a Chinese physicist. He was a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite book|title=中国科学家辞典 • 现代第二分册|author=徐志春主编; 孙敦恒, 于欣, 陆嘉玉等副主编|publisher=山东科学技术出版社|year=1983|isbn=|location=济南|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=中华当代文化名人大辞典|author=张品兴, 殷登祥, 陈有进等主编|publisher=中国广播电视出版社|year=1992|isbn=9787504315137|location=北京|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=二十世纪中国名人辞典|author=蔡开松, 于信凤主编; 曾卓明, 周溯源, 赵书刚副主编|publisher=辽宁人民出版社|year=1991|isbn=|location=沈阳|pages=}}</ref>
